name: Enemy
description: The genre-neutral hostile marker: a real component class carrying no data, so targeting, scoring and impact code can ask `entity.get(EnemyComponent)` type-safely instead of string-matching an `'enemy'` tag a rename would silently break. There is no EnemySystem — a marker states a fact and leaves acting on it to whoever cares. The twin-stick swarm brain that used to hold this name is now `TwinStickEnemy`.
